body:
This PR appears unnecessary, as the pair code is logically symmetrical at the high level.

However, I have tested it in my game and I can assert that it shouldn't change anything (if someone wanted to merge it to make the code look less buggy). 

My personal recommendation is to close this to get it off the list because:
* That will be the easiest for a maintainer.
* I think the code as it is provides useful information. It announces "The pair class must be symmetrical, otherwise how could I be flipping the parameters like this".
* If you merge this, behaviour may change slightly at the edge, since the floating point pathways could change.
